page_title: Esen Tunalı Sarı — Founder & Creative Director
meta_description: Discover the personal story of Esen Tunalı Sarı, the software developer and creative director harmonising artificial intelligence with bespoke jewellery design at SILVER & ELEGANT.
heading: The Creative Technologist

sections.label: My story
sections.body: Esen Tunalı Sarı is the Founder and Creative Director of SILVER & ELEGANT. A Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts (FRSA), her practice merges architectural rigor, computational form, and traditional metal discipline. Shaped by living and working across Bulgaria, Turkey, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom, her London-based studio approaches jewellery not as ornament, but as structural art intended for permanence.

sections.label: Design Philosophy
sections.body:
SILVER & ELEGANT operates at the intersection of architectural precision and singular craftsmanship. Our work spans classical physical production and algorithmic concepts, each piece engineered for single-artisan physical execution in Istanbul. Through the Physical Fidelity Protocol, our digital and physical iterations maintain absolute geometric alignment.

Permanence is structural. The work exists where calculated form meets the discipline of metal.

We build sculptural forms informed by architectural minimalism. SILVER & ELEGANT rejects disposable design in favour of deliberate permanence. Every work is conceived as a future heirloom: structural, enduring, and resolved.
sections.label: Brand Vision

sections.body:
Founded in London in January 2025 by Esen Tunalı Sarı, FRSA, the studio develops high-concept sculptural jewellery with rigorous design discipline.

  

1.  **London Fashion Week AW26:** Official Jewellery Partner to Paul Costelloe for the runway opening presentation.
2.  **Industry Recognition:** Finalist for Business Innovation at the SME Hertfordshire Business Awards 2026; Featured Designer at Not Just A Label (NJAL); selected for Wolf & Badger Editor's Picks.
3.  **Editorial:** Featured in _Flanelle Magazine_ and _KALTBLUT Magazine_.
sections.label: Career Highlights

sections.body:
The studio develops work across two distinct streams: classical physical designs and algorithmic concepts. To govern this duality, we created the Physical Fidelity Protocol — an internal system ensuring absolute geometric and material accuracy between digital generation and the true physical object. Visuals never distort reality.

###
sections.label: Methodology: Physical Fidelity Protocol

sections.body: Every piece is conceived in London and engineered for single-artisan physical execution in Istanbul's Grand Bazaar. We prioritize singular, focused craftsmanship over mass assembly. Physical editions are completed entirely by hand by a master artisan; pending algorithmic concepts remain formally resolved prior to fabrication.
